terms.sub: These Terms are part of the Purchase Agreement. Read them before signing.

runs.text: The seller under this Agreement is FACTORY DIRECT HOMES CENTER, LLC, an Indiana limited liability company (“Dealer”). Buyer contracts with the company only. No member, manager, officer, employee, sales representative or agent of Dealer is a party to this Agreement or assumes any personal liability under it, and Buyer agrees to look solely to the assets of the company for satisfaction of any claim. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency or fiduciary relationship between Dealer and Buyer, or between Dealer and any contractor Buyer engages.

Dealer is selling the manufactured home described on Page 1 as tangible personal property. Dealer is NOT contracting to permanently affix the home to real estate, is NOT acting as a construction contractor, and is NOT making an improvement to real property. Any foundation, permanent attachment, site improvement or utility work is contracted for separately by Buyer with Buyer's own providers, as set out in Section 2 of Page 1 and in the Factory Direct Sale and Non-Installation Disclosure.

The tax treatment of this sale is set by the state the home is delivered to, as selected on Page 1, and is detailed in the State Tax, Title and Installation Addendum, which is part of this Agreement. In summary: for an INDIANA delivery, Dealer collects Indiana sales tax on sixty-five percent (65%) of the selling price under IC 6-2.5-5-29 and Indiana Department of Revenue Sales Tax Information Bulletin #65, the selling price includes delivery, set-up and utility connections sold by Dealer, and Dealer completes and files Form ST-108MH. For an OHIO delivery, no Indiana sales tax is collected; under Ohio Revised Code 5739.0210 the dealer, not the purchaser, is the consumer of a new manufactured or mobile home, so Dealer owes Ohio use tax measured by Dealer's cost at the rate in the county where the home is titled to the purchaser, Dealer may not charge that tax to Buyer as a tax, and Dealer's price accounts for it. For a MICHIGAN delivery, no Indiana sales tax is collected and Buyer declares and pays Michigan use tax, currently six percent (6%), together with the title fee, when Buyer applies for the Certificate of Manufactured Home Ownership with the Michigan Secretary of State. For any OTHER STATE, no Indiana sales tax is collected on a carrier delivery out of Indiana and Buyer is responsible for the destination state's tax, titling and registration. The sale of a pre-owned manufactured home is exempt from Indiana sales tax. Amounts Buyer contracts directly with third parties are not part of the selling price and are not taxed by Dealer. Dealer does not give tax advice, and Buyer should confirm the destination state's requirements with Buyer's own advisor.

The contingency selected in Section 4 of Page 1 governs. If a contingency is selected and is not removed or satisfied in writing on or before the contingency deadline, either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice, and Buyer's deposit will be refunded less the $250.00 document preparation fee and less any third-party costs Dealer has actually incurred and documented. If “NO CONTINGENCY — AUTHORIZATION TO BUILD” is selected, or if Buyer signs the Authorization to Build, no contingency exists, the home is released to production, and all deposits become non-refundable.

The price stated on Page 1 is based on the manufacturer's pricing in effect on the date of this Agreement. Changes to the home, options, colors or specifications may be made only by a written change order signed by Buyer and accepted by Dealer and, where required, by the manufacturer, and may incur additional charges and delay. If Buyer has not authorized construction, or if the manufacturer imposes a price increase, surcharge, tariff, or material cost adjustment between the date of this Agreement and the date construction is authorized, the Agreement amount will be adjusted to cover that increase, and Buyer may terminate within seven (7) days of written notice of the increase with a refund of deposits less the document preparation fee.

All deposits and payments are applied by Dealer to its obligations under this Agreement, including payments to the manufacturer, transporters and other third-party vendors, and to administrative, credit card and cancellation costs. Except as expressly stated in this Agreement, all payments are NON-REFUNDABLE. Requests to terminate or for a refund must be in writing; verbal requests will not be considered. All refunds are subject to a $250.00 cancellation and document preparation fee plus any processing fees, are processed within fourteen (14) business days after the written request, clearance of funds, and management authorization, and credit card payments are refunded only to the original card.
7. Financing (applies when DEAL TYPE is FINANCE).

Dealer does not extend credit and is not a lender. Buyer is responsible for obtaining financing and for satisfying all lender conditions, including appraisal, title, land, insurance and site requirements. Buyer authorizes Dealer to forward Buyer's application information to prospective lenders at Buyer's request. Dealer does not take loan applications on its own behalf, does not offer or negotiate credit terms, does not advise Buyer on loan terms, and receives no compensation from any lender for the referral. Loan approval is not a guarantee of funding. If a lender declines to fund after Buyer has authorized construction, Buyer remains liable under this Agreement.
8. Cash Transactions (applies when DEAL TYPE is CASH).

The unpaid balance is due in certified funds, cashier's check or wire transfer as stated on Page 1. Dealer is required by 26 U.S.C. § 6050I and 31 U.S.C. § 5331 to report to the Internal Revenue Service on Form 8300 the receipt of more than $10,000 in cash or cash equivalents in one transaction or in related transactions, and to furnish Buyer with a written statement of that report. Buyer agrees to provide the identification information required to complete that report.
9. Delivery; Title and Risk of Loss.

Delivery dates are estimates only. Dealer arranges transportation from the manufacturing facility to the homesite and bills that freight as shown on Page 1. Risk of loss passes to Buyer upon delivery of the home to the homesite or to any location designated by Buyer. Buyer is responsible for insurance on the home from the time the manufacturer completes it. If Buyer's site is not ready and delivery cannot occur within three (3) days after factory completion, storage charges of $75.00 per day accrue and must be paid before shipment, and Buyer is responsible for arranging and paying for a secure storage location if Dealer cannot provide one.

Buyer is solely responsible for: acquiring or lawfully occupying the homesite; site preparation, grading, compaction, drainage and foundation; legal and physical access adequate for transport and placement equipment; all permits, zoning, setback, flood zone, fire code and Wildland Urban Interface requirements; utility availability and connections; and any community or landlord approval. Dealer may require copies of permits before delivery.
11. Installation by Others; No Referral Liability.

Dealer does not install the home. Buyer selects, hires, directs and pays all contractors, who must be licensed, bonded and insured as required by the State of Indiana and the local jurisdiction. Dealer does not warrant, supervise or accept responsibility for the referral, selection, workmanship, timeliness, licensing or insurance of any contractor engaged by Buyer, including any contractor whose name appears in Section 2 of Page 1 or in any quote furnished to a lender.

The home is covered by the manufacturer's written limited warranty furnished with the home. That warranty is the manufacturer's obligation. Dealer is a separate legal entity, does not adopt, assume, extend or guarantee the manufacturer's warranty, and does not warrant or service the home.
13. DISCLAIMER OF IMPLIED WARRANTIES BY DEALER.

DEALER MAKES NO WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, WITH RESPECT TO THE HOME. DEALER EXPRESSLY DISCLAIMS ALL IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY AND THE IMPLIED WARRANTY OF FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AS PERMITTED BY IC 26-1-2-316. AS BETWEEN DEALER AND BUYER, THE HOME IS SOLD “AS IS” WITH RESPECT TO DEALER ONLY. THIS DISCLAIMER DOES NOT LIMIT, REDUCE OR AFFECT THE MANUFACTURER'S WRITTEN LIMITED WARRANTY, ANY RIGHTS BUYER HAS AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER, OR ANY RIGHT THAT CANNOT LAWFULLY BE DISCLAIMED.

IN NO EVENT IS DEALER LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, EXEMPLARY OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOSS OF USE, LOST PROFITS, DELAY DAMAGES, STORAGE, MOVING COSTS, TEMPORARY HOUSING, RENT, LOAN INTEREST OR LOSS OF BARGAIN, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT, THE HOME, ITS DELIVERY, OR ANY DELAY, EVEN IF DEALER HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES. DEALER'S TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT WILL NOT EXCEED THE AMOUNT BUYER HAS ACTUALLY PAID TO DEALER.

Buyer is in default if Buyer fails to make any payment when due, fails to accept delivery, fails to have the site ready, repudiates this Agreement, or fails to perform any obligation. On default, Dealer may, in addition to all remedies available at law: retain all deposits and payments as liquidated damages, which the parties agree is a reasonable estimate of Dealer's loss and is not a penalty given the custom-ordered nature of the home; resell the home and recover from Buyer the difference between the Agreement price and the resale price; and recover floorplan interest, storage, transportation, re-work, marketing costs, and reasonable attorney fees, expert fees and costs of collection.

Dealer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time before delivery. On such termination, Buyer's sole remedy is the return of payments made toward the Agreement, together with a full accounting, within ten (10) business days, and Buyer waives any claim for consequential or other damages, including lost use and lost profits.

Buyer will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Dealer and its members, managers, employees and agents from and against all claims, demands, actions, losses, liabilities, damages, expenses and costs, including actual attorney fees and costs of investigation, arising out of or resulting from: Buyer's site, its condition or access; work performed by any contractor engaged by Buyer; Buyer's failure to employ properly licensed, bonded and insured contractors; Buyer's failure to obtain required permits or approvals; or Buyer's breach of this Agreement.

Dealer may assign this Agreement or any payment due under it to any lender, floorplan lender or financial institution without notice. Buyer may not assign this Agreement without Dealer's prior written consent.

Buyer authorizes Dealer and any lender to whom Buyer's information is submitted to obtain consumer reports and to verify the information Buyer provides, for the purpose of evaluating this transaction and any credit application, consistent with the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

Dealer collects nonpublic personal information, which may include Social Security or taxpayer identification numbers required by Form ST-108MH and by title application. Dealer uses that information only to complete this transaction and to comply with law, shares it only with the manufacturer, lender, titling authority, taxing authority and transporters as necessary, and maintains reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect it.

Buyer consents to be contacted by Dealer by telephone, text message, email and mail at the numbers and addresses provided on Page 1, including by automatic telephone dialing system or prerecorded or artificial voice, regarding this transaction, delivery, service and Dealer's products and offers. CONSENT TO MARKETING MESSAGES IS NOT A CONDITION OF PURCHASE. Message and data rates may apply. Buyer may withdraw consent for marketing messages at any time by replying STOP to any text message, by using the unsubscribe link in any email, or by written notice to Dealer. Transaction and service messages may continue.

Buyer consents to the use of electronic records and electronic signatures for this Agreement and all related documents under the federal ESIGN Act and the Indiana Uniform Electronic Transactions Act. An electronic signature has the same effect as an original. Buyer may request paper copies at no charge. Buyer represents that Buyer can access and retain documents in PDF form at the email address provided.

This Agreement was negotiated and executed at Dealer's licensed place of business at 1211 IN State Road 8, Auburn, Indiana, and is not a home solicitation sale. If this Agreement was in fact solicited and signed at Buyer's residence or at a location other than Dealer's place of business, Buyer's cancellation rights under 16 CFR Part 429 and IC 24-5-10 apply and a separate Notice of Cancellation is attached and incorporated.

Dealer sells and does business without regard to race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status, national origin, or any other status protected by the federal Fair Housing Act, the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, and Indiana law. Buyer and Dealer will comply with all applicable federal, state and local law in performing this Agreement.

Dealer is not liable for delay or failure to perform caused by shortage or delay of materials, weather, site conditions, contractors, the manufacturer, lenders, transportation, labor disputes, government action, or any other cause beyond Dealer's reasonable control.
Disputes are governed by the HUD Manufactured Home Dispute Resolution Program Disclosure and the Arbitration Clause included in this Agreement, which are incorporated by reference.

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Indiana without regard to conflict of laws principles. Subject to the Arbitration Clause, venue for any action lies exclusively in the state courts located in DeKalb County, Indiana, and the parties consent to that jurisdiction.
28. Entire Agreement; Amendment; Severability; Waiver; Survival.

This Agreement, together with all pages, addenda, disclosures and change orders listed on the Document Checklist, is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous representations, whether verbal or written. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties. If any provision is held unenforceable, the remainder stays in effect. Dealer's failure to enforce any provision is not a waiver. Sections concerning warranty disclaimer, limitation of liability, indemnification, dispute resolution, governing law and venue survive delivery, performance and termination.

Notices must be in writing and delivered by hand, by certified mail, or by email with confirmation of receipt, to Dealer at 1211 IN State Road 8, Auburn, Indiana 46706, and to Buyer at the mailing address and email on Page 1.
This Agreement is an offer by Buyer until it is accepted in writing by a Manager or Member of Factory Direct Homes Center, LLC. No sales representative has authority to bind Dealer.
BY SIGNING BELOW, BUYER ACKNOWLEDGES HAVING READ AND RECEIVED A COPY OF THESE TERMS AND CONDITIONS, INCLUDING THE DISCLAIMER OF IMPLIED WARRANTIES AND THE LIMITATION OF LIABILITY.

disclosure.title: Factory Direct Sale and Non-Installation Disclosure
disclosure.sub: Please read this entire page. If you do not understand all or part of this notice, we will explain it to you.

disclosure.text: Your satisfaction with your new home is our highest priority. To help you understand our factory-direct model, we want to be clear about who is responsible for what.

runs.text: Factory Direct Homes Center, LLC sells you the manufactured home, orders it from the manufacturer, and arranges and bills the transportation of the home from the manufacturing facility to your homesite as shown on Page 1. Title and risk of loss pass to you when the home is delivered to your site.

Dealer does not install your home, does not perform site work, and does not act as a construction contractor or general contractor. Dealer does not attach the home to real estate. You choose, hire, direct and pay every contractor who works on your site or your home.

disclosure.text: Buyer understands that, unless an item is specifically listed and priced on Page 1 as sold by Dealer, Buyer is responsible for the following:

Choosing, hiring, arranging and paying all contractors needed to install the home. Contractors must be licensed, bonded and insured to perform all services on your home. State and local law generally require a licensed installer. Check with the State of Indiana and your local municipality for requirements that apply to your site.

All aspects of home installation, homesite and land improvements, and obtaining all permits required to comply with state and local licensing agencies. Factory Direct Homes Center reserves the right to request copies of building permits from Buyer prior to delivery of the home.

All aspects of home installation including but not limited to blocking, leveling, anchoring, drywall marriage line and repairs, interior door adjustment, carpet installation, interior and exterior trim, final cleaning, and purchase and installation of all light bulbs.

If the home is equipped with interior tape and texture treatment, minor stress cracks less than the thickness of two quarters and less than 24 inches in length are Buyer's responsibility. These may appear during transportation, placement, and as the home settles, particularly around windows and doors. Extreme cracking can be caused by shipment over rough terrain and sharp turns and by setting the home into position with crawlers, cranes or helicopters. Buyer is responsible for repairing these areas and completing the marriage line close-up at Buyer's expense.

Interior doors are square and even when the home ships from the factory. If doors get out of square, this is not a warranty item, and doors must be adjusted and fixed into place at Buyer's expense by the installation contractor.
Homes do not come with an air conditioning unit or hook-up unless specifically listed on Page 1 or Addendum “A”. Buyer is responsible for purchasing, installing and connecting air conditioning.

Evaporative coolers mounted on the ground and ducted through the floor vent system are not recommended by Factory Direct Homes Center or by the manufacturer. Past experience shows damage will occur in most cases.
All aspects of homesite and land improvements including but not limited to septic, well preparation, utility connections, driveway and clearing.

Verifying that the manufactured home is compatible with the site, including community approval and city and county zoning requirements. Buyer must provide the transport company legal and physical right of way over which the home can be delivered. If the site is not prepared, we recommend a compaction test to determine suitability.
Utility service facilities for manufactured home spaces are not standardized. Compatibility between a chosen manufactured home space and the home being purchased is Buyer's responsibility.

If local zoning requires a permanent foundation or architectural changes, it is Buyer's responsibility to notify the contractor. If the home requires special blocking or tie-downs because of flood plain restrictions, it is Buyer's responsibility to arrange and pay for that work. Buyer is responsible for obtaining and paying for all permits. All utility connections and installation of the home are Buyer's responsibility.

Ensuring the home meets state, county and local codes for fire safety. Buyer must provide all Wildland Urban Interface (WUI) code requirements to the sales representative before the home goes into production. Failure to do so leaves Buyer financially responsible for correcting the home to meet WUI requirements. If Buyer plans additions such as a garage, add-on, porch or deck, Buyer is responsible for ensuring those structures comply with local WUI codes.

Factory Direct Homes Center is not responsible for the referral, selection or workmanship of contractors hired by Buyer, including any contractor whose name or quote appears anywhere in this Agreement or in a lender packet.

Please be advised that certain delays can occur that are beyond everyone's control, such as shortage or delay of materials, bad weather, property conditions including wet ground, an improperly prepared delivery site, contractors, manufacturers, lenders, transportation problems including road construction and equipment failure, acts of God, or any other cause beyond our control. Should these conditions exist, we cannot guarantee an exact delivery date. We ask that in the event of unavoidable delay you have suitable backup plans until delivery can be completed. Factory Direct Homes Center will not be financially responsible for delays, and in some circumstances the Buyer may be held financially responsible.

If the home requires special equipment because of a complicated placement, it is Buyer's responsibility to ensure proper equipment and personnel are hired to handle final placement on the delivery date. This may include but is not limited to sharp curves, riverbeds, ravines, steep inclines, soft ground, or crossing adjacent property. Neither Dealer nor the transport company guarantees proper placement where delivery is complicated. If final placement cannot occur on the day of delivery, Buyer is responsible for finding a secure location for the home and for final placement.

The quoted freight price does not include unique or complicated placement. Unless otherwise noted, the price is for standard delivery only. Any additional fees incurred because of complicated placement, standby time, re-delivery, or a site that is not ready are Buyer's responsibility.

warranty.text: Buyer understands that the home comes with a limited warranty provided by the manufacturer. The manufacturer and/or the original builder is responsible for all warranty and approved service work that may be needed on the home.

All cosmetic items must be reported within thirty (30) days of shipment. These include scratches, dents, cuts, blemishes and similar items. After the home is installed, Buyer will perform a walk-through inspection and report, in writing, any warranty service items. Written requests for service may be sent to Factory Direct Homes Center, 1211 IN State Road 8, Auburn, IN 46706. Fax copies are not accepted. For more information regarding the home warranty, refer to the Homeowner's Manual provided by the manufacturer.

Any work that would be covered by the manufacturer's warranty and is performed without prior approval from the manufacturer is not subject to reimbursement by the manufacturer or by Factory Direct Homes Center, LLC.

Factory Direct Homes Center, LLC is a separate legal entity from the manufacturer. Dealer does not warranty or service the home, and does not adopt, assume, extend or guarantee the manufacturer's warranty.

payment.title: Payment Disclosure, Refund and Termination Policy

payment.text: Down payments and any subsequent payments, collectively “Payments”, made toward the Purchase Agreement and provided to Factory Direct Homes Center as consideration under the Purchase Agreement are handled in compliance with applicable state and federal law.

Buyer consents to Factory Direct Homes Center using the Payments to complete its obligations under the Purchase Agreement, including to pay the manufacturer, transporters and other third-party vendors, and to cover administrative, credit card and other costs and cancellation fees.

runs.text: All Payments are NON-REFUNDABLE to Buyer, except as expressly stated otherwise in the Purchase Agreement.

If requested by Buyer, Factory Direct Homes Center may, in its sole discretion, refund a portion of the Payments. Any request to terminate the Purchase Agreement or to refund part of the Payments must be made in writing. Verbal requests to terminate or for a refund will not be considered.

payment.text: All refunds, regardless of notation, are subject to a cancellation fee of two hundred fifty dollars ($250.00) for document preparation, plus any applicable processing fee and any third-party cost actually incurred and documented by Dealer.

Any refund request will be processed within fourteen (14) business days after receipt of the written request, validation that payments have cleared the bank, and final authorization by company management. Any refund of Payments made by credit card will be issued only to the original card used in the transaction, less any processing fees per the card agreement. All other refunds will be issued by check payable to the Buyer named in the Purchase Agreement and mailed by U.S. Mail.

runs.text: EFFECT OF THE AUTHORIZATION TO BUILD

payment.text: Before Buyer signs the Authorization to Build on Page 1, and while a contingency selected on Page 1 remains open, Payments are refundable less the $250.00 document preparation fee and documented third-party costs. Once Buyer signs the Authorization to Build, the home is released to the manufacturer for production, is built to Buyer's specific selections, and cannot be cancelled. From that point all Payments are non-refundable and Buyer remains liable for the full Contract Total.

runs.text: TERMINATION BY FACTORY DIRECT HOMES CENTER

payment.text: Factory Direct Homes Center may, at its option, terminate the Purchase Agreement at its convenience at any time before delivery. Buyer agrees that upon termination for convenience, Buyer's sole remedy is the return of Payments made toward the Purchase Agreement. Buyer waives any claim for consequential and other damages, including lost use and lost profits, arising from or related to that termination. A full accounting and the refund will be issued within ten (10) business days of the termination.

If Buyer defaults, Dealer may retain all Payments as liquidated damages, resell the home, and recover from Buyer the difference between the Agreement price and the resale price together with floorplan interest, storage, transportation, re-work, marketing costs and reasonable attorney fees and costs of collection, as set out in the Terms and Conditions.

runs.text: HUD MANUFACTURED HOME DISPUTE RESOLUTION PROGRAM

federal.text: The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Manufactured Home Dispute Resolution Program is available to resolve disputes among manufacturers, retailers and installers concerning defects in manufactured homes. Many states also have a consumer assistance or dispute resolution program. For additional information about these programs, see the sections titled “Dispute Resolution Process” and “Additional Information — HUD Manufactured Home Dispute Resolution Program” in the Consumer Manual required to be provided to the purchaser. These programs are not warranty programs and do not replace the manufacturer's or any other person's warranty program.

This home is a HUD-code manufactured home built to the Federal Manufactured Home Construction and Safety Standards, 24 CFR Part 3280 The federal construction standard is the same in every state, but titling, tax and installer licensing are NOT — those follow the state the home is delivered to, and the State Tax, Title and Installation Addendum in this Agreement governs them. It is NOT a modular home and is not built to a state or local building code. Each transportable section carries a HUD certification label, and a data plate inside the home identifies the manufacturer, serial number, date of manufacture, wind zone, roof load zone, thermal zone and the appliances installed. Buyer should confirm that the wind, roof load and thermal zones shown on the data plate are correct for the county where the home will be sited. The manufacturer's installation instructions, issued under 24 CFR Part 3285, must be followed by the installer, and failure to follow them may void the manufacturer's warranty.

arbitration.title: Dispute Resolution and Arbitration Clause
arbitration.sub: PLEASE READ CAREFULLY. THIS SECTION AFFECTS YOUR LEGAL RIGHTS.

arbitration.text: When available, Buyer may seek assistance from the HUD Manufactured Home Dispute Resolution Program to resolve issues associated with this Agreement. In cases where the HUD Dispute Resolution Program is not available, the parties will first attempt to mediate any pending dispute relating to this Agreement through a mediator mutually agreeable to the parties.

In the event that one or both parties do not wish to mediate or cannot agree upon a mediator, the parties agree that the dispute resolution mechanism for any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be arbitration before a single arbitrator, in accordance with the then-current Consumer Arbitration Rules of the American Arbitration Association or any successor organization (the “AAA”). The arbitration proceeding shall be initiated and the hearing shall take place in the county and state where the home was purchased, except where the transaction was conducted solely online, in which case the proceeding will be conducted in a location reasonably convenient to both parties.

The party desiring to initiate arbitration shall give written notice to the other party including a brief statement of its claims. Within fifteen (15) business days of that notice, the parties shall meet to attempt to jointly select a single AAA-approved arbitrator. If they are unable to agree, either party may apply to the AAA for appointment of a single arbitrator under the rules then in effect. Any arbitrator selected shall be a member of the State Bar of Indiana with at least ten (10) years' experience practicing business law in the State of Indiana.

The arbitrator may, at the written request of a party, consolidate multiple party claims that are substantially identical and all claims arising out of a single transaction. The decision of the arbitrator shall be final and binding upon and non-appealable by the parties, and judgment may be entered on the award in any court of competent jurisdiction. The arbitrator shall have the right to determine their own jurisdiction and shall provide the parties a reasonable opportunity for discovery as the arbitrator deems appropriate. The cost of arbitration and the arbitrator's fee shall be allocated between the parties pursuant to the Consumer Arbitration Rules, and the arbitrator may award the prevailing party attorney and expert fees and other costs as the Consumer Arbitration Rules permit.

runs.text: Each party expressly waives any right to a jury trial with respect to any matter subject to arbitration under this clause.

Claims must be brought in the party's individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective, consolidated or representative proceeding. The arbitrator may not consolidate the claims of more than one person except as expressly provided above and may not preside over any form of class proceeding.

Either party may bring an individual action in a small claims court of competent jurisdiction instead of arbitration, so long as the action remains in that court and is brought on an individual basis.

Buyer may reject this Arbitration Clause by delivering written notice to Factory Direct Homes Center, LLC, 1211 IN State Road 8, Auburn, IN 46706, postmarked or emailed within thirty (30) days after the date Buyer signs this Agreement, stating Buyer's name, the date of this Agreement, and that Buyer rejects the Arbitration Clause. Rejecting this clause will not affect any other term of this Agreement and will not affect Buyer's purchase.

runs.text: HOW THE HOME WILL BE TITLED

title.text: A HUD manufactured home in Indiana is titled through the Bureau of Motor Vehicles on an Application for Certificate of Title (State Form 205), supported by the Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin and by Form ST-108MH. ALL OWNERS MUST SIGN THE APPLICATION FOR TITLE, even if joint tenancy was previously established in another jurisdiction. If titling in a company name, Buyer must provide the company's EIN.

runs.text: NAME(S) EXACTLY AS THEY SHOULD APPEAR ON TITLE
AFFIDAVIT OF TRANSFER TO REAL ESTATE (STATE FORM 51408)

title.text: If the home is placed on land Buyer owns and Buyer or Buyer's lender wants the home treated as real property rather than as titled personal property, Indiana provides an Affidavit of Transfer to Real Estate. Filing it surrenders the certificate of title and converts the home to real estate for ownership, taxation and lending purposes. It generally requires that the home be permanently affixed, that Buyer own the land, and that any lien on the home be released or re-recorded against the real estate.

runs.text: IMPORTANT:  Whether the home is converted to real estate does not change how Indiana sales tax is computed on this sale. Sales tax is computed on 65% of the selling price at the time of the retail sale under IC 6-2.5-5-29, regardless of what Buyer does with the title afterward. Conversion also generally cannot be reversed, and it changes how the county assesses and taxes the property.

runs.text: Ohio tax is the Dealer's obligation, not the Buyer's

stateaddendum.text: Under Ohio Revised Code 5739.0210, on the sale of a NEW manufactured or mobile home the DEALER is the consumer of that sale, not the purchaser. Ohio tax is measured by what the Dealer paid the manufacturer for the home, not by the price Buyer pays Dealer, and it is assessed at the total rate in effect in the county where the home is titled to the purchaser. Dealer remits that tax to Ohio on a consumer's use tax return. The statute does not allow Dealer to charge that tax to Buyer as a tax. Dealer's selling price accounts for it as a cost.

runs.text: For that reason there is no Ohio tax line on Page 1 and Buyer is not asked to pay Ohio sales tax to Dealer at closing. Buyer should not expect a tax credit, refund or separate tax statement from Dealer for this sale.

stateaddendum.text: Because Dealer owes Ohio tax on these transactions, Dealer registers with the Ohio Department of Taxation and reports the tax on an Ohio consumer's use tax account. Ohio also requires an out-of-state dealer with nexus in Ohio to be registered as an out-of-state seller with the Department of Taxation. Dealer, not Buyer, is responsible for that registration and for the returns.

runs.text: YOU MAY CANCEL THIS TRANSACTION, WITHOUT ANY PENALTY OR OBLIGATION, WITHIN THREE BUSINESS DAYS FROM THE ABOVE DATE.

cancellation.text: If you cancel, any property traded in, any payments made by you under the contract or sale, and any negotiable instrument executed by you will be returned within ten business days following receipt by the seller of your cancellation notice, and any security interest arising out of the transaction will be cancelled.

If you cancel, you must make available to the seller at your residence, in substantially as good condition as when received, any goods delivered to you under this contract or sale; or you may, if you wish, comply with the instructions of the seller regarding the return shipment of the goods at the seller's expense and risk.

If you do make the goods available to the seller and the seller does not pick them up within twenty days of the date of your notice of cancellation, you may retain or dispose of the goods without any further obligation. If you fail to make the goods available to the seller, or if you agree to return the goods to the seller and fail to do so, then you remain liable for performance of all obligations under the contract.
